reviewer: Claude 2, independent; did not author the subject
discipline: Refute, do not confirm. The subject is a leftover remasurement whose single new claim is that leftover-design of the per-D-002-platform copies of the NT-1/NT-2 payloads has gone stale after D-243. That claim was attacked physically rather than textually: the eight copy files were listed on disk, each was digested and compared byte-for-byte against the two frozen v1 payload digests, and the fixture tree was listed to confirm no Windows directory was created. The authoring artifact the claim rests on, g21-fixture-corpus.v2, was read for what it declares it did NOT author and for its platform provenance, and that list was set against the subject's enumerated remainder to test whether the remainder is now under-stated. The controlling passProperty in occupancy v4 was read in full and set against the subject's rendition, because a truncation of that clause was the evidentiary core of the finding this lineage landed at v6. Every digest recorded anywhere in the file was recomputed from disk. The subject was diffed against its frozen predecessor v7 field-by-field, so that every field the remasurement did NOT touch was examined for staleness rather than assumed carried. The structurally identical sibling that reached this exact transition first, g23-leftover-join.v8, was read as precedent for what a correct disposition ledger looks like at this position.
decisionRule: ACCEPT only at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX. Zero MUST-FIX stand and one SHOULD-FIX stands, so the verdict is REJECT.
codexStanding: Contents not read. This verdict is Claude 2's alone and no part of it is informed by the other reviewer. Disclosure: a directory listing run for an unrelated custody purpose incidentally revealed that docs/coop/artifacts/g21-leftover-join.v8.review-independent.codex.json exists. The file was never opened and its verdict, findings, count and schema are unknown to this review. Existence alone was not treated as evidence of anything, and the finding below was already fully derived and written up before that listing ran.
reviewerDisclosure: This review occupies the Claude 2 slot, and that slot authored the independent reviews of g21-leftover-join v1 through v7, of harness.DR-G21.component-failure-containment v3 and v4, of g21-named-corpus-catalog.v1, g21-input-corpus.v1, g21-fixture-corpus.v1 and v2, and of the doctor-actor leftover-join lineage. Several of those are pinned inputs here, and v5's and v6's findings had to be read in full to audit appliesFindingsOf. The bias runs strongly toward ACCEPT twice over: the slot accepted v7 at 0/0 and accepted the corpus v2 this successor consumes at 0/0, so v8 presents as a routine delta between two artifacts this slot already blessed. That bias was countered by refusing to treat any field as carried forward: the remainder was re-derived from corpus v2's own whatIsNotAuthored and from occupancy v4's passProperty rather than from v7's accepted text, the copies claim was tested against the physical fixture tree rather than against corpus v2's assertion about itself, and every field left untouched by the v7-to-v8 diff was audited for staleness against the new measurement. The finding raised below is in exactly that class: it is not a defect in the delta, but a sentence the delta failed to move, which is the specific defect this bias would otherwise hide. This reviewer did not author the subject.

shouldFixFindings.title: appliesFindingsOf.v5[G21LJ-V5-M1].landed still asserts in the present tense that leftover-design of the per-D-002-platform copies remains — the exact claim this remasurement exists to retire — and contradicts seven live fields of the subject's own ledger.
shouldFixFindings.charge: The subject's whole reason for existing is to move one fact: after g21-fixture-corpus.v2 (D-243) authored the platform copies, leftover-design of those copies is stale as an authoring claim. The subject makes that move correctly and consistently in every operative field. It then carries, unmoved from v7, a disposition entry whose first sentence reads 'leftover-design of per-D-002-platform copies of the authored NT-1/NT-2 payloads remains.' That sentence is unanchored to any version and is in the present tense, so it reads as a live statement of the remainder. It is the negation of the subject's own new measurement, sitting in the same file. A reader auditing this ledger for the one fact it was written to establish gets two opposite answers.
evidence: Live subject appliesFindingsOf.v5[0] reads in full: ids ['G21LJ-V5-M1'], disposition 'ACCEPTED', landed 'leftover-design of per-D-002-platform copies of the authored NT-1/NT-2 payloads remains. Occupancy v4 passProperty is quoted including every D-002 platform. No D-002 platform list is invented.' The second and third sentences remain true of v8; the first does not.

The subject contradicts that sentence in seven live fields: authorityClaim ('leftover-design of per-D-002-platform copies of those implementations is stale as an authoring claim'); purpose ('Measure leftover-design of per-D-002-platform copies of NT-1/NT-2 stale as an authoring claim'); leftoverDesignOpenStanding ('Eight per-D-002-platform copies of those implementations exist at g21-fixture-corpus.v2 (D-243). leftover-design of those copies is therefore stale as an authoring claim'); obligations[3].reason; obligations[3].existingGate, which drops v7's 'none as per-D-002-platform copies of authored NT-1/NT-2 implementations' limb; obligations[3].remainingNotAuthored, which deletes v7's perD002PlatformCopiesOfAuthoredNt1Nt2 key outright; and doesNotCloseLeftoverAlone.

The v7-to-v8 diff shows appliesFindingsOf is byte-identical between the two versions. At v7 the sentence was accurate and live. The remasurement moved every other field that carried this claim and left this one behind.

In this lineage the landed texts are audited against live bytes rather than read as free history. The v6 review's landedFindingAudit measures G21LJ-V5-M1's landed text as 'ACCURATE — fully landed' by resolving each of its limbs against live artifacts, and cites the presence of remainingNotAuthored.perD002PlatformCopiesOfAuthoredNt1Nt2 as one of the grounds. That structural ground has been deleted at v8 while the prose asserting it remains.

The structurally identical sibling that reached this exact transition first shows the correct formulation. g23-leftover-join.v8 — a leftover-join remasuring after g23-fixture-corpus.v4 authored that lineage's platform copies, recorded at D-240 — carries findingDisposition['CLAUDE-G23LJ-V6-M1'] = 'ACCEPTED at v7 as leftoverDesign scoped to per-D-002-platform copies. This v8 remasures that scoped remainder stale after corpus v4.' It anchors the landing to its version and states the flip in the same breath. The subject does neither.

The subject demonstrates it knows how to anchor a disposition to a version: findingDisposition[G21LJ-V3-SF1].landed reads 'Landed in this lineage at v4. Unmoved. Not this artifact's version number.' The appliesFindingsOf entries carry no such anchor.

The underlying measurement is correct and is not challenged by this finding. All eight copies were verified on disk under docs/coop/artifacts/fixtures/g21.v2/ across macos-arm64, macos-x86_64, linux-x86_64 and linux-arm64, each byte-equal to the frozen v1 payload digests b9ff9338… and bc264fc7…; no Windows directory exists; corpus v2's whatIsNotAuthored no longer lists per-platform copies, and lists only 'a D-002 platform list' and 'Windows as a copied platform'.
shouldFixFindings.whyShouldFix: The error runs in the conservative direction — it over-states the surviving remainder rather than closing something that is still open — and the operative ledger is unaffected: leftoverDesignRemainingOnG21, summary.leftoverDesign and remainingNotAuthored are all correct, OBL-G21-FX-AUTHORING stays leftoverDesign true, and leftoverDesignClosedIfAcceptedAndRecorded correctly stays empty. Nothing is wrongly closed and no gate moves, so this is not a MUST-FIX. But a leftover-join's sole deliverable is an accurate remainder ledger, and this is an internal contradiction about the single fact the artifact was authored to record, in a field this lineage's own review standard resolves against live bytes. A recorded join carrying a live sentence that its own successor-measurement is false is the kind of drift the v5 and v6 findings in this lineage were about.
shouldFixFindings.repairDirection: Rewrite appliesFindingsOf.v5[0].landed to anchor the landing and state the flip, following the dual-ACCEPTed G23 v8 precedent — for example: 'ACCEPTED at v6 as leftoverDesign scoped to per-D-002-platform copies. This v8 remasures that scoped remainder stale after corpus v2. Occupancy v4 passProperty is quoted including every D-002 platform. No D-002 platform list is invented.' Do not author copies, do not name a platform, and do not close leftover-design of OBL-G21-FX-AUTHORING, which remains true on the unauthored classes.

landedFindingAudit.detail: The finding charged obligations[3].reason with attributing to corpus v1's authoredCatalog.executionRemains a three-item routing that field does not carry — inventing 'Host-refusal observation' and dropping 'host-projection goldens'. Live subject obligations[3].reason now reads 'corpus v1 authoredCatalog.executionRemains, carried by corpus v2: Qualification. Pinning authored bytes is not execution and is not SATISFIED. Candidate-buffer digest, subsequent-session view, and host-projection goldens remain G21 execution (D-056), not leftover-design.' That matches live corpus v1's field verbatim in its three routed items. The string 'refusal' occurs zero times in the subject. 'host-projection goldens' is restored and also appears in leftoverDesignOpenStanding, in OBL-G21-EXECUTION.reason and in proposedLaterWork. The claimed landing text is accurate.

doesNot carries 'Does not SATISFY DR-133.' and summary carries dr133Satisfied false. DR-133 attribution is present in prose across registerRowNote, authorityClaim, purpose, leftoverDesignOpenStanding and obligations[3].reason. DR-133 is nowhere claimed satisfied. The claimed landing text is accurate.

The substantive repair the finding demanded is intact where it must be: the passProperty rendition still preserves every enumerated class and the 'on every D-002 platform' qualifier, and no platform token appears anywhere in the subject. What has gone stale is the landed text's own first sentence, which asserts a remainder the subject elsewhere measures as no longer standing. Raised as G21LJ-V8-SF1 rather than re-raised as a MUST-FIX, because the original defect — an under-stated remainder — is not what recurred; the recurrence is an over-statement in a disposition field.

observationsNotFindings.observation: parentReview.role's trailing negative example still reads 'not leftover-join.v4' although v7, not v4, is now the current recorded predecessor. The sibling corpus v2, authored at the same D-243 moment, updated its identical sentence to 'not leftover-join.v7'.
observationsNotFindings.whyNotAFinding: The affirmative clause 'Naming parent is D-145 / naming v6' is true, verified against live COORD, and is exhaustive on its own — it identifies the naming parent positively, so no other artifact is left readable as that parent. The trailing clause is a non-exhaustive example, not a claim that only v4 is excluded, and it makes no false statement. The string has been the lineage's fixed formulation since v5 and passed dual review at v7. v7's standing is separately and correctly stated in registerRowNote, remeasurementClause and doesNot. Nothing reads v7 as the naming parent, so the attack this guards against is refuted on the affirmative clause alone.

decision: REJECT — 0 blockers, 0 MUST-FIX, 1 SHOULD-FIX (G21LJ-V8-SF1). The remasurement itself is sound and physically verified: the eight platform copies exist, are byte-equal to the frozen v1 payloads, Windows is correctly not copied, every cited digest reproduces, required-now stays 28, and nothing is closed, satisfied, executed or invented. The subject retires the copies remainder in every operative field but leaves one disposition sentence asserting that same remainder still stands, contradicting its own central measurement. Under the decision rule, one SHOULD-FIX forces REJECT.
